description: This file implements Sentry integration for frame processor metrics within a larger software project. It defines the class `SentryMetrics`, which extends `FrameProcessorMetrics` to send performance data such as time-to-first-byte and processing metrics as transactions to Sentry, a monitoring tool.

classes.name: SentryMetrics
classes.description: A class that extends FrameProcessorMetrics to integrate Sentry monitoring for frame processing metrics.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SentryMetrics object, setting up internal state and verifying Sentry SDK initialization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Sentry metrics system, initializing the queue and background task for handling Sentry transactions.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up Sentry resources and ensures all transactions are flushed before shutdown.

methods.name: start_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Starts tracking time-to-first-byte metrics, creating a Sentry transaction if available.

methods.name: stop_ttfb_metrics
methods.description: Stops tracking TTFB metrics and queues the transaction for completion.

methods.name: start_processing_metrics
methods.description: Starts frame processing metrics, initiating a Sentry transaction.

methods.name: stop_processing_metrics
methods.description: Stops frame processing metrics and queues the transaction for completion.

methods.name: _sentry_task_handler
methods.description: Background task handler that processes queued Sentry transactions, finishing each asynchronously.

methods.name: setup(self, task_manager: BaseTaskManager)
methods.description: Async setup method to initialize Sentry monitoring queue and task, using the task manager.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Async cleanup method to flush and terminate Sentry transactions gracefully.

methods.name: start_ttfb_metrics(self, report_only_initial_ttfb)
methods.description: Starts TTFB measurement, initiating a Sentry transaction if enabled.

methods.name: stop_ttfb_metrics(self)
methods.description: Stops TTFB measurement, queuing the transaction for completion.

methods.name: start_processing_metrics(self)
methods.description: Starts processor metrics, creating a Sentry transaction.

methods.name: stop_processing_metrics(self)
methods.description: Stops processor metrics, queuing the transaction.

methods.name: _sentry_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Background async function to process and finish Sentry transactions queued for transmission.
